_note: Lookup tables for the TODAY IN SXM engine. Hand-editable. Figures from Sint Maarten Dept. of Statistics 2025 actuals; refresh annually.

bridges._note: Published times are when a bridge is PREPARED to open, not when it will. No boats, no opening. Causeway is on-demand only - locals report never seeing it open. Simpson Bay causes the bulk of island traffic. All three are free to cars; the fee is charged to boats.

simpson_bay.label: Simpson Bay Bridge
simpson_bay.connects: Simpson Bay and the airport to Cole Bay and Philipsburg
simpson_bay.detour: west past the airport and over the Causeway - roughly double the distance

sandy_ground.label: Sandy Ground Bridge
sandy_ground.connects: Marigot to Baie Nettle and Terres Basses
sandy_ground.detour: none - the long way round via Cupecoy on the Dutch side

causeway.label: Causeway Bridge
causeway.connects: Airport Road to Union Road, Cole Bay
causeway.detour: Welfare Road through Simpson Bay village

swell._note: Calibrated against a 40-year eastern Caribbean swell study (JMSE 2022). The ordinary east trade state is 1.5-1.7m at 8.1-8.2s, so the old 1.5m/9s trigger fired on about half of all days. North swell - the dangerous regime - is 2.0-2.5m at 10.2-10.6s and occurs on 16% of Nov-Apr days.
